description: Use before and after executing or releasing a change whose failure would be costly, such as security, permissions, payments, data loss, schema migration, production deploy or global settings; an unlisted change counts too if it is hard to reverse or affects other people or public state. An auditor separate from the author checks the final change and verification evidence directly and judges whether it can be completed. Not for simple research, low-risk fixes, general code review or design talk without implementation.
